hedging_examples.quote: GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be 74.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points.
hedging_examples.note: Uses 'plus or minus' to indicate uncertainty around the margin forecast.

hedging_examples.quote: We expect GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates to be between 16.0% and 18.0%, excluding any discrete items and material changes to our tax environment.
hedging_examples.note: Uses a range ('between 16.0% and 18.0%') to indicate uncertainty about tax rate.

hedging_examples.quote: We are not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in our outlook.
hedging_examples.note: Explicitly states an assumption that is not guaranteed, hedging the China revenue contribution.

positive_signals.quote: Revenue for the second quarter was a record $96.2 billion, up 106% from a year ago and up 18% sequentially.
positive_signals.note: Highlights record revenue and strong growth percentages.

positive_signals.quote: Data Center revenue for the second quarter was a record $89.0 billion, up 117% from a year ago and up 18% sequentially, driven by the ramp of our Blackwell Ultra infrastructure.
positive_signals.note: Emphasizes record Data Center revenue and attributes growth to Blackwell Ultra.

positive_signals.quote: Hyperscale revenue more than doubled from a year ago and increased 13% sequentially on the strength of Blackwell Ultra.
positive_signals.note: Highlights significant growth in Hyperscale revenue and its driver.

positive_signals.quote: Edge Computing revenue for the second quarter was $7.2 billion, up 27% from a year ago and up 13% sequentially.
positive_signals.note: Shows strong growth in Edge Computing revenue.

positive_signals.quote: We continue to make strategic commitments across our supply, infrastructure, and partner ecosystems to capitalize on the substantial growth opportunities ahead of us.
positive_signals.note: Signals confidence in future growth through strategic commitments.

negative_signals.quote: Shipments of Data Center Hopper products to China during the quarter were less than 1% of Data Center revenue.
negative_signals.note: Indicates minimal exposure to China Data Center revenue, which could be a concern.

negative_signals.quote: Edge Computing revenue for the second quarter was $7.2 billion, up 27% from a year ago and up 13% sequentially. The increases were driven by strong sales of Blackwell workstations, partially offset by slower consumer PC sales that were tempered by elevated memory and systems prices.
negative_signals.note: Notes slower consumer PC sales and pricing pressures as a headwind.
